name: White pudding

reason: Cooked class lacks a bloodless cereal sausage; farmfetch shows hogs pudding only, so the generic type goes to HV_NK; hogs pudding then its named form.

name: Half-moon edger (edging iron)
definition: long-handled tool with a flat half-moon blade pushed in by foot to cut a clean lawn edge.
reason: Form differs from the string trimmer (C10: manual and powered share a kind only when the form is the same).

name: Broadfork
definition: two-handled wide fork with long tines, rocked back to loosen soil deeply without turning it.
reason: Sold by name; two-handled frame form unlike the garden fork; C2.1 then holds 14 kinds (display groups unchanged).

name: Grass shears
definition: shears with short blades, one-handed or on long handles, for trimming grass at lawn edges by hand.
reason: Sold as its own type; hedge shears are long-bladed two-handed shears for shrubs; trims lawn edges, so C2.3.2.

name: Garden tiller (rotavator)
definition: powered machine with rotating tines that digs and breaks up soil for beds and plots.
reason: Powered tool of a different form from the hand cultivator is its own kind (precedence 2); B&Q class 'scarifiers & rotavators'.

name: Hose spray gun (hose nozzle)
definition: hand-held nozzle or gun fitted to a hose end to shape and stop the water jet for hand watering.
reason: Sold as its own category by hose makers; neither hose nor can; hand watering role in the water path.

definition: click-on or screw connector, tap connector or coupling that joins garden hoses to taps, tools and each other.
reason: Hose fittings are a shop category; kept in C2.5 by the designed-function test (tree precedence, against K-186 plumbing).

name: Water lily (Nymphaea)

reason: Canonical pond plant sold under its own name; no harvester page names it, so HV_NK attests (†).

name: Lotus (Nelumbo)

reason: Pond plant sold under its own name; no harvester page, HV_NK attests (†).

reason: Generic tool behind 'bookbinding'; logged page shows the class only, so attest in HV_NK.
